name: Avalon
description: A nature-driven faction built around equal parts growth, diversity, and aggression, with substantial utility and powerful finishers.

name: Metropolis
description: A faction of steampunk elves and their mechanical marvels, preferring utility and countermeasures over direct assault.

name: Thalassa
description: A seafaring faction built around Ships, Pirates, and Warriors. Best for players who favor direct frontal assault without subtlety.

name: Transylvania
description: Transylvania – A chaotic criminal underworld where vampires, mobsters, and slayers operate in uneasy cooperation. Excels at taking apart the opponent’s strategy before it can develop.

name: Vulcania
description: A faction of dwarven industry, drunken revelry, and fiery dragons. Prioritizes greedy strategies and defense, with limited offensive resources.

name: Unaffiliated
description: A faction for cards which do not belong to any particular faction.
